title: The Student Recreation Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Gym facilities, recreation programs, equipment, and membership requirements. The Student Recreation Database records campus recreation facilities with hours, equipment, program offerings, intramural sports, and membership or fee requirements from published sources. Records note what is included in student fees versus what costs extra. The Signature side adds beginner program finders matching interests to low-pressure entry points.
capabilities: Record recreation facilities with hours and equipment
List programs, classes, and intramural sports
Document membership and fee requirements
Distinguish fee-included access from paid extras
Match beginners to entry-level programs by interest
